name: Jiangsu Nata Opto-electronic Material Co., Ltd.
summary: Jiangsu Nata Opto-electronic Material Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, production, and sale of electronic materials in China, the United States, and internationally. The company offers precursor materials, such as MO source, customized products, novel silicon precursor, ALD/CVD, and OLED materials; electronic specialty gases, including hydrogen-based electronic specialty gases and fluorine-based electronic specialty gases; and photoresist supporting materials. Its products are used in integrated circuits, compound semiconductors, LED, photovoltaics, flat panel displays, petrochemical, and power industries. The company was founded in 2000 and is based in Suzhou, China.
